90_90_Hamstring: Lie on your back and raise one leg with the hip and knee bent at 90 degrees, holding your thigh with your hands.
Straighten your knee until you feel tension at the back of your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds breathing calmly and switch legs.
Adductor: Lie face down and place the roller under the inner side of one thigh, with that leg out to the side.
Roll slowly from the knee to the groin.
Pause for a few seconds on tight spots. 30-60 seconds per leg.
Adductor_Groin: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out to the sides.
Let gravity open your knees without forcing.
All_Fours_Quad_Stretch: Bring one foot back and hold it with the hand on the same side, drawing your heel towards your glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Ankle_Circles: Sitting, or standing on one leg, lift one foot off the floor.
Draw wide circles with your ankle in one direction and then the other.
Do 10 circles each way and switch feet.
Ankle_On_The_Knee: Lie on your back with your knees bent and rest one ankle on the opposite knee.
Hold the thigh of the supporting leg and draw it towards your chest until you feel the stretch in your glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Anterior_Tibialis-SMR: Get on all fours with the roller under the front of your shins.
Roll slowly from the ankle to just below the knee.
Arm_Circles: Stand with your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Draw small circles that gradually get bigger.
Do 10-15 in one direction and then the other.
Behind_Head_Chest_Stretch: Standing or seated, interlace your hands behind your head.
Draw your elbows back, opening your chest.
Brachialis-SMR: Lie on your side and rest the outside of your arm, just above the elbow, on the roller.
Calf_Stretch_Elbows_Against_Wall: Rest your forearms on a wall and step one leg back with the heel on the floor.
Lean into the wall until you feel the stretch in your calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Calf_Stretch_Hands_Against_Wall: Put your hands on a wall and step one leg back, straight, with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and move your hips towards the wall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Calves-SMR: Sit with the roller under your calves and your hands on the floor behind you.
Lift your hips and roll slowly from the ankle to the knee. Cross one leg over the other to increase the pressure.
Cat_Stretch: Get on all fours with your back flat.
Round your back towards the ceiling, tucking your chin, then gently arch it, looking ahead.
Alternate both movements slowly, following your breath.
Chair_Leg_Extended_Stretch: Sit on the edge of a chair and stretch one leg out in front with the heel on the floor.
Lean your torso forward with a straight back until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Chair_Lower_Back_Stretch: Sit on a chair with your feet flat and apart.
Lean forward, letting your torso and arms drop between your legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and come up slowly.
Chair_Upper_Body_Stretch: Sit on a chair and hold the backrest behind you with both hands.
Push your chest forward, opening your shoulders.
Chest_And_Front_Of_Shoulder_Stretch: Rest your palm and forearm on a door frame with your elbow at shoulder height.
Turn your body the other way until you feel the stretch in your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Chest_Stretch_on_Stability_Ball: Kneel next to an exercise ball and rest one straight arm on top.
Let your chest drop towards the floor until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Childs_Pose: Kneel and sit back on your heels.
Lean forward until your forehead rests on the floor, arms stretched out in front or along your body.
Relax your back and breathe slowly for 30 seconds or more.
Chin_To_Chest_Stretch: Sitting or standing, with your back straight.
Bring your chin towards your chest; you can help with your hands behind your head, without pulling.
Crossover_Reverse_Lunge: Standing, step back crossing one leg diagonally behind the other.
Lower into a lunge, feeling the stretch in your hip and glute.
Dynamic_Back_Stretch: Stand with your arms straight out in front.
Rotate your torso from side to side smoothly, letting your arms follow.
Dynamic_Chest_Stretch: Stand with your arms straight out in front at chest height.
Open them backwards until you feel the stretch in your chest and bring them together again.
Elbow_Circles: Stand with your hands on your shoulders.
Draw circles with your elbows, first forwards and then backwards.
Elbows_Back: Stand with your hands on your lower back, fingers pointing down.
Draw your elbows back as if to bring them together and open your chest.
Foot-SMR: Standing or seated, place the sole of one foot on a small ball or roller.
Roll slowly from heel to toes with the pressure you can tolerate.
Frog_Hops: Get into a deep squat with your hands on the floor between your feet.
Hop gently forward, landing in the squat again.
Link several short hops with control.
Front_Leg_Raises: Stand next to a wall, supporting yourself with one hand.
Swing the opposite leg forwards and backwards, gradually increasing the range.
Groin_and_Back_Stretch: Sit with the soles of your feet together and hold your ankles.
Lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Groiners: Step one foot next to the hand on the same side, feeling the stretch in your groin.
Return to the start and alternate.
Hamstring-SMR: Sit with the roller under the back of your thighs and your hands on the floor behind you.
Lift your hips and roll from the knee to the glute.
Hamstring_Stretch: Lie on your back and raise one straight leg, holding it behind the thigh or with a strap.
Draw it closer until you feel the stretch, without bending the knee.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Hip_Circles_prone: Lift one knee out to the side and draw wide circles with it.
Do 10 circles each way and switch legs.
Hug_A_Ball: Sit on the floor with your legs apart and an exercise ball between them.
Hug it, leaning your torso forward.
Hug_Knees_To_Chest: Bring both knees to your chest and hug them.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, relaxing your lower back.
IT_Band_and_Glute_Stretch: Lie on your back and cross one leg over the other with the knee bent.
Pull the knee towards the opposite shoulder with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Iliotibial_Tract-SMR: Lie on your side with the roller under the outside of your thigh.
Roll slowly from the hip to just above the knee, supporting yourself with your arms and other leg.
Inchworm: Standing, bend at the hips and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a push-up position.
Walk your feet towards your hands with your legs as straight as possible and repeat.
Intermediate_Groin_Stretch: Lie on your back with one leg straight up.
Open it out to the side with a strap or your hand, without twisting your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Intermediate_Hip_Flexor_and_Quad_Stretch: Kneel in a lunge position with your back knee on the floor.
Hold your back foot and draw it towards your glute while pushing your hips forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Knee_Across_The_Body: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one bent knee across to the opposite side, rotating your hips, with your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Knee_Circles: Stand with your feet together, knees slightly bent and hands on them.
Draw gentle circles with your knees.
Kneeling_Forearm_Stretch: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with your fingers pointing towards your knees.
Gently move your hips back until you feel the stretch.
Kneeling_Hip_Flexor: Kneel in a lunge position with your back knee on the floor.
Push your hips forward, squeezing the glute of the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Latissimus_Dorsi-SMR: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit and your arm stretched overhead.
Roll slowly along the side of your back.
Leg-Up_Hamstring_Stretch: Standing, rest the heel of one leg on a box or low step, with the leg straight.
Lean your torso forward from the hips with a straight back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Looking_At_Ceiling: Kneel with the tops of your feet on the floor and your torso upright.
Reach your hands to your heels, push your hips forward and look at the ceiling, gently arching your back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the front of your thighs, and come back slowly.
Lower_Back-SMR: Sit with the roller under your lower back and your arms crossed over your chest.
Roll gently over the lower back, without pressing directly on the spine.
30-60 seconds. If it hurts, do not insist.
Lying_Crossover: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Cross one leg over the other towards the opposite side, keeping your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Lying_Glute: Lie on your back with your knees bent and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Draw both legs towards your chest, holding the lower thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Lying_Hamstring: Lie on your back and loop a strap or towel around the sole of one foot.
Raise the straight leg by pulling the strap until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Lying_Prone_Quadriceps: Bend one knee and hold your foot with your hand, drawing your heel towards your glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Middle_Back_Stretch: Stand with your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side as far as you can without moving your hips.
Hold for a few seconds and switch sides.
Neck-SMR: Lie on your back with a small roller or ball under the back of your neck.
Turn your head slowly from side to side with gentle pressure.
On-Your-Back_Quad_Stretch: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed, with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the knee of that leg and hold the foot, drawing it towards your glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
On_Your_Side_Quad_Stretch: Lie on your side with your head resting on your arm.
Bend your top knee and hold the foot, drawing your heel towards your glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
One_Arm_Against_Wall: Standing facing a wall, place one hand on it at hip height.
Push your hips back with your arm straight until you feel the stretch along the side of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
One_Handed_Hang: Hang from a bar with one hand, feet close to or touching the floor.
Relax your shoulder and let your weight stretch your side.
Hold as long as you can with control and switch hands.
One_Knee_To_Chest: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee to your chest and hug it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Overhead_Lat: Standing, raise one arm overhead and grab a post or door frame.
Push your hips to the opposite side until you feel the stretch along your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Overhead_Stretch: Stand and interlace your hands overhead.
Stretch your arms up and slightly back.
Overhead_Triceps: Raise one arm, bend the elbow and reach your hand down your back.
With the other hand, gently push the elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch arms.
Pelvic_Tilt_Into_Bridge: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Press your lower back into the floor by tilting your pelvis and, from there, lift your hips one vertebra at a time.
Peroneals-SMR: Lie on your side with the roller under the outside of your lower leg, between knee and ankle.
Piriformis-SMR: Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Lean towards the side of the crossed leg and roll slowly over the glute.
Quad_Stretch: Standing, hold on to something stable.
Bend one knee and hold the foot with your hand, drawing your heel towards your glute with your knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Quadriceps-SMR: Lie face down on your forearms with the roller under your thighs.
Roll slowly from just above the knee to the hip.
Rear_Leg_Raises: Swing one straight leg backwards with control.
Rhomboids-SMR: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back and your arms crossed.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades.
Round_The_World_Shoulder_Stretch: Stand holding a stick or band with a very wide grip in front of your thighs.
Take it overhead and behind your back with your arms straight.
Return along the same path. Widen your grip if you feel discomfort.
Runners_Stretch: Get into a lunge with your hands on the floor either side of your front foot.
Sink your hips down, feeling the stretch in the hip of your back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Scissor_Kick: Lie on your back with your hands under your glutes and your straight legs slightly raised.
Cross your legs over each other, alternating, like scissors.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Seated_Biceps: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you, fingers pointing back.
Slide your hips forward until you feel the stretch in your arms.
Seated_Calf_Stretch: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Pull your toes towards you with your hand or a towel.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Seated_Floor_Hamstring_Stretch: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front.
Lean your torso towards your feet with a straight back.
Seated_Front_Deltoid: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your hands on the floor behind you.
Slide your hands back and let your chest open.
Seated_Glute: Sitting on a chair, rest one ankle on the opposite knee.
Lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Seated_Hamstring: Sit with one leg straight and the other bent, foot against the inner thigh.
Lean towards the foot of the straight leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Seated_Hamstring_and_Calf_Stretch: Sit with your legs straight and loop a towel around the sole of one foot.
Pull the towel towards you, leaning your torso with a straight back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Seated_Overhead_Stretch: Sitting with your back straight, interlace your hands overhead.
Shoulder_Circles: Draw circles with your shoulders, first forwards and then backwards.
Shoulder_Stretch: Bring one straight arm across the front of your chest.
With the other hand, pull it towards your body just above the elbow.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch arms.
Side-Lying_Floor_Stretch: Lie on your side with your top arm stretched overhead.
Stretch your whole side, reaching your arm and leg in opposite directions.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Side_Leg_Raises: Stand leaning on a wall with one hand.
Swing the opposite leg out to the side, crossing it in front on the way back.
Side_Lying_Groin_Stretch: Lie on your side propped up on one elbow.
Raise your top leg, holding it by the ankle or knee.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Side_Neck_Stretch: Sitting or standing, with your back straight.
Tilt your head, bringing your ear towards your shoulder; you can rest your hand on top without pulling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Sit_Squats: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down and your elbows gently pushing your knees outwards.
Spinal_Stretch: Sit with your legs straight and cross one over the other, foot flat next to the knee.
Rotate your torso towards the bent leg, resting the opposite elbow against the knee.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Standing_Biceps_Stretch: Stand and interlace your hands behind your back with your arms straight.
Raise your arms slightly, turning your palms down.
Standing_Elevated_Quad_Stretch: Stand with your back to a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Bend the standing leg with your torso upright until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Standing_Gastrocnemius_Calf_Stretch: Place the front of one foot on a step or against the wall with the heel on the floor.
Lean your body forward with the leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Standing_Hamstring_and_Calf_Stretch: Standing, step one foot forward with the heel on the floor and the toes up.
Lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Standing_Hip_Circles: Stand with your hands on your waist.
Draw wide circles with your hips.
Standing_Hip_Flexors: Standing, take a long step forward.
Bend your front knee slightly and push your hips forward, squeezing the back glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Standing_Lateral_Stretch: Lean your torso to the opposite side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Standing_Pelvic_Tilt: Stand with your knees slightly bent and your hands on your hips.
Tilt your pelvis forwards and backwards gently.
Standing_Soleus_And_Achilles_Stretch: Put your hands on a wall and step one foot forward.
Bend both knees with your heels on the floor until you feel the stretch low in the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.
Standing_Toe_Touches: Lean forward trying to touch your toes, without forcing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and come up slowly.
Superman: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a few seconds and lower with control.
The_Straddle: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and wide apart.
Lean your torso forward or towards one leg with a straight back.
Toe_Touchers: Lie on your back with your legs straight up towards the ceiling.
Lift your shoulders off the floor, trying to touch your feet with your hands.
Torso_Rotation: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat and your arms straight out in front.
Rotate your torso from side to side without moving your hips.
Tricep_Side_Stretch: Bring one arm across your chest and bend the elbow.
With the other hand, push the elbow towards the opposite shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch arms.
Triceps_Stretch: Raise one arm, bend the elbow and reach your hand down your back.
With the other hand, gently push the elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch arms.
Upper_Back_Stretch: Stand and interlace your hands in front of your chest with your arms straight.
Push your hands forward, rounding your upper back.
Upward_Stretch: Stand and interlace your hands overhead, palms facing up.
Stretch your whole body towards the ceiling, going up on your toes if you like.
Windmills: Stand with your legs apart and your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and bring one hand towards the opposite foot.
Come back up and alternate sides.
Worlds_Greatest_Stretch: Take a long step forward and place the opposite hand on the floor.
Bring the elbow on the same side as the front leg towards the ankle, then rotate, opening that arm towards the ceiling.
Wrist_Circles: Standing or seated, with your hands clasped or free.
Draw circles with your wrists in one direction and then the other.
